_doc: Per-card mechanics beyond raw stats: abilities, evolutions, hero forms. Seeded from research notes; entries marked verified:false still need checking (see TOMORROW.md).

tower_troops.name: Tower Princess
tower_troops.notes: Default tower troop; hits air & ground. HP from RoyaleAPI Royal Chef comparison; dmg/hit speed from a secondary source (verify).

tower_troops.name: Cannoneer
tower_troops.notes: Epic, Nov 2023 / Arena 8. Hits air & ground; ~4x a Princess arrow per shot but slow (175 dps).

tower_troops.name: Dagger Duchess
tower_troops.notes: Legendary, Apr 2024. Fires up to 8 stored daggers rapidly, then slow recharge when idle. HP/dmg from fandom wiki (older source says 3204/153); hit speed approximate.

tower_troops.name: Royal Chef
tower_troops.notes: Legendary, Dec 2024 / Arena 13. Slightly lower HP and DPS than Tower Princess (damage value not found; hit speed/range stated to match Tower Princess). Starts cooking Pancakes at 7s (18-30s each); a Pancake gives a nearby troop with >=20% HP a +1 level. Oct 2025 HP 2921->2703.

evolution.effect: Takes heavily reduced damage while walking toward a target.
Arrows pierce through units; longer range while standing still.

hero.ability: Banner Brigade: last Goblin drops a banner that calls reinforcements (count 3->2 Aug 2026); ability cost 1->2 Apr 2026

evolution.effect: Spawn 4; each Skeleton kill spawns a new one, up to 8 alive.
Bombs bounce and explode a second time; cycles 1->2 in Oct 2025.
Added Apr 2026; effect not verified.
Barbarians enrage (faster move/attack) after landing hits.
Cannon recoil: each shot knocks back enemies behind/around him.
Added Aug 2026; effect not verified.
Freezes for longer and leaves a slowing frost area.

electro_spirit.name: Electro Spirit
electro_spirit.notes: kamikaze; chains to up to 9 targets, 0.5s stun

heal_spirit.name: Heal Spirit
heal_spirit.notes: kamikaze; heals friendly troops in area

evolution.effect: Bats heal themselves on every hit (life steal).
After the stun, lightning chains again to nearby enemies.
Snowball rolls across the arena, growing and knocking back enemies.

royal_delivery.name: Royal Delivery
royal_delivery.notes: delayed drop; spawns one Royal Recruit

evolution.effect: Each shell also launches a Goblin that fights on landing.
Fires rolling cannonballs that knock back and pass through enemies.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.notes: hides underground when idle; immune to spells while hidden

evolution.effect: Emerging/retracting emits a shock pulse that stuns and pushes back enemies.

goblin_cage.name: Goblin Cage
goblin_cage.notes: spawns Goblin Brawler (hp ~1187, dmg ~266) on death

evolution.effect: Releases an evolved, stronger Goblin Brawler on destruction.

rascals.name: Rascals
rascals.notes: 1 Rascal Boy (melee tank) + 2 Rascal Girls (ranged, hp ~260)

royal_recruits.name: Royal Recruits
royal_recruits.notes: each has a 286 hp shield; spawn across both lanes

evolution.effect: Recruits gain a shield-bash dash toward nearby targets.

skeleton_barrel.name: Skeleton Barrel
skeleton_barrel.notes: drops ~8 skeletons on death with small area damage

evolution.effect: Barrel bounces/drops extra Skeletons and bombs on the way.
Sparks leave lingering burning area damage after the explosion.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.notes: attacks faster the lower her hp

suspicious_bush.name: Suspicious Bush
suspicious_bush.notes: disguised bush; spawns 2 Goblins when destroyed or at tower

evolution.effect: Sniper stance: extra range and damage while standing still.
Added Nov 2 2026; effect not verified.

hero.ability: Heroic Hurl: throws the highest-HP enemy troop across the arena

evolution.effect: Spinning creates a tornado that pulls enemies toward her.

hero.ability: Whirl: mobile area damage (ability dps 388->324 in Dec 2026 WIP)

evolution.effect: Spawns with a shield; when it breaks, a fire blast knocks back enemies.

hero.ability: Fiery Flight / Fire Wings: flies and throws fire tornadoes
Wounding Warp: warps to lowest-HP enemy

battle_ram.name: Battle Ram
battle_ram.notes: charges after 3 tiles (2x damage); spawns 2 Barbarians on death

evolution.effect: Barbarians keep charging/ramming after the ram breaks.
Darts apply poison damage over time.

elixir_golem.name: Elixir Golem
elixir_golem.notes: splits into 2 Golemites then 4 Blobs; each death gives opponent elixir

royal_hogs.name: Royal Hogs
royal_hogs.notes: can be split across lanes; jump the river

goblin_demolisher.name: Goblin Demolisher
goblin_demolisher.notes: throws bombs; lights fuse at low hp and explodes for large area damage

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.notes: ~4x damage to buildings; slows ground troops; ignores air

evolution.effect: Hot Spawns: while attacking, spawns Fire Spirits every 2.4s (was 1.8s) from its sides.

hero.ability: Destroying it raises Tomb Queen (building-targeting win condition; 4044 HP after Jul 2026 buff, ability 6->5 elixir)

inferno_tower.name: Inferno Tower
inferno_tower.notes: damage ramps from ~32 to ~1200 per 0.4s; reset by stun

barbarian_hut.name: Barbarian Hut
barbarian_hut.notes: spawns Barbarians periodically; spawns Barbarians on death

battle_healer.name: Battle Healer
battle_healer.notes: heals nearby allies on attack and passively

rune_giant.name: Rune Giant
rune_giant.notes: empowers 2 nearby allies with rune magic (bonus area damage)

evolution.effect: Breath leaves burning ground (released Sep 2025).
Periodically unleashes a bigger wave of Skeletons.

giant_skeleton.name: Giant Skeleton
giant_skeleton.notes: drops a bomb on death (~1300 area damage)

hero.ability: Coffin Cadets: Skeletons jump off and fight

bowler.name: Bowler
bowler.notes: rolling boulder pierces and knocks back

evolution.effect: Axe arc widens and hits more times on return.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.notes: 10 pellets; full damage only at point blank

evolution.effect: Shots pull/knock targets toward him for point-blank damage.
Chain lightning jumps to more targets with longer stun.

golem.name: Golem
golem.notes: splits into 2 Golemites with death damage

evolution.effect: Heals herself from damage dealt (life steal) [unverified].

cannon_cart.name: Cannon Cart
cannon_cart.notes: 1147 hp shield; becomes a stationary cannon (~1057 hp) when shield breaks

goblin_giant.name: Goblin Giant
goblin_giant.notes: carries 2 Spear Goblins that attack from his back and drop on death

evolution.effect: Periodically spawns extra Spear Goblins from his backpack (spawn speed nerfed Sep 2025).
Leave bombs behind on death that detonate shortly after.

electro_giant.name: Electro Giant
electro_giant.notes: zaps and stuns anything attacking him in melee range

evolution.effect: Added Oct 2026; effect not verified.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.notes: replays last card at +1 elixir and +1 level

evolution.effect: Added Nov 2 2026; effect not verified.

tornado.name: Tornado
tornado.notes: pulls troops to center; activates king tower

barbarian_barrel.notes: rolls ~5 tiles then spawns a Barbarian

evolution.effect: Throws a second (decoy/delayed) barrel alongside the real one.

goblin_drill.name: Goblin Drill
goblin_drill.notes: can be placed anywhere; spawns Goblins; 2 Goblins on death

evolution.effect: Bigger drill spawns Goblins along its tunnel path.

void.name: Void
void.notes: damage split among units: huge to a single unit, small to swarms

goblin_curse.name: Goblin Curse
goblin_curse.notes: cursed troops take +20% damage and turn into Goblins on death

inferno_dragon.name: Inferno Dragon
inferno_dragon.notes: damage ramps from ~30 to ~350 per 0.4s; reset by stun

evolution.effect: Beam ramps faster and splits/arcs to a second target.
Added Jun 2026; effect not verified.

miner.name: Miner
miner.notes: can be placed anywhere; reduced damage to towers

lumberjack.notes: drops a Rage spell on death

evolution.effect: Drops a larger/longer Rage on death that also affects buildings.

electro_wizard.name: Electro Wizard
electro_wizard.notes: zaps on spawn; hits 2 targets with 0.5s stun

night_witch.name: Night Witch
night_witch.notes: spawns Bats every 5s; 2 Bats on death

ram_rider.name: Ram Rider
ram_rider.notes: charges after 3 tiles; rider snares troops with bolas

fisherman.name: Fisherman
fisherman.notes: hooks and pulls a target to him

evolution.effect: Chains repeated jump attacks while enemies remain in range.

phoenix.notes: leaves an egg that rehatches into a Phoenix unless destroyed

spirit_empress.notes: summons spirits; form depends on elixir state

archer_queen.champion_ability: champion ability: Cloaking Cape, invisible with faster attacks (1 elixir)

goblinstein.champion_ability: Monster (tank, targets buildings) + Doctor (ranged); champion ability: Lightning Link electrocutes between them (2 elixir)

boss_bandit.name: Boss Bandit
boss_bandit.notes: dashes (double damage) when target is 3.5-6 tiles away; champion ability Getaway Grenade (1 elixir): turns invisible, teleports back 6 tiles and dashes; 2 charges, 3s cooldown (Jul 2025 rework)
boss_bandit.champion_ability: dashes (double damage) when target is 3.5-6 tiles away; champion ability Getaway Grenade (1 elixir): turns invisible, teleports back 6 tiles and dashes; 2 charges, 3s cooldown (Jul 2025 rework)

vines.name: Vines
vines.notes: Released Sep 1 2025 (Season 75). Entangles the 3 highest-HP units in a 2.5-tile radius for 2.5s; grounds air units so ground troops can hit them. Damage: 405 total at launch (162 dps x 2.5s); Sep 5 2025 emergency nerf 162->134 dps (~335 total); further Oct 2025 nerf (numbers not found). Verified: cost/rarity/radius/mechanic; damage approximate.

ronin.name: Ronin
ronin.notes: Released Jul 6 2026 (Season 85 Honor & Exile). Melee, ground-only. Parry: every 3.5s blocks one incoming ground melee hit and reflects 200% of it; spawns with parry charged. Aug 2026 bug-fix: first hit time 0.3->0.4s. Damage sources conflict (371 vs 337 at L11); 337 is the more recent figure. Reduced tower damage multiplier (WIP note, unconfirmed).

minion_giant.name: Minion Giant
minion_giant.notes: Released Sep 7 2026 (Season 87 Minion Academy, Academy Antics album event). Flying building-targeter that spits toxin from 4 tiles. Launch 189 dmg; Sep 16 2026 nerf 189->168 (-11%). All figures community-sourced (LDPlayer/noff/trophycoach), not from Supercell notes.
